title: XAUCE
tagline: Sauce for your web3 dapp to flavor your own creation to be stored on chain or ipfs.
description: This project was made to provide flavor to your web3 dapp experience by implementing one or more of the protocols from the sponsors for WEB3JAM. By using this dapp you are to be able to create a randomly generated SVG NFT via a livestream from livepeer and then save that NFT/METADATA on chain and or IPFS.
how_its_made: I started with Nick Mudge's Diamond standard and Austin Griffith's Scaffold-Eth. The backend uses Solidiity through Hardhat, Javascript/Typescript with React and Ant for the frontend.Livepear API, Infura, etherscan and a few other apis to populate the data. As the livefeed is running, random capture based on certain criteria specified by the user.
